project_context: Gym Axis Homepage - B2B Service Desk Addition
theme: LIGHT with a DARK Breakout Section

typography.headings: Use existing font stack but apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter to large headings. Avoid default bold, use font-light or font-medium to create E1 tension.
typography.hierarchy_rules: H2 for the new section must not exceed text-4xl sm:text-5xl.

colors.service_desk_accent: orange-500 (#f97316). Use strictly for the Service Desk product highlights and its specific CTA.
colors.new_section_bg: slate-950 (#020617) - Use this for the new Service Desk section wrapper to create a high-contrast 'break' in the page flow, signaling a different target audience (Service Companies vs Gyms).

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use py-24 or py-32 for the new Service Desk section to give it massive breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align text in the new section. Asymmetrical balance with the mockup taking up the right column.

header_nav.instruction: Rename the 'Engineers' tab to 'Partners' (or 'Service Network' if i18n prefers). This encompasses both Suppliers/Companies and individual Engineers without crowding the nav.

service_desk_section.content_left: High-contrast typography. Focus on: self-serve signup, 4-step setup wizard, smart dispatch, owner analytics. CTA: 'Start 14-day free trial' pointing to /service-provider/signup.
service_desk_section.content_right_mockup: CRITICAL: Build the screenshot as a JSX/Tailwind mockup (like LiveCustomerAppPreview). NO PNGs. Light-themed UI, rounded-xl, shadow-2xl. Sidebar layout (Dashboard, Cases, Scheduler, Customers, Equipment, Parts, Billing, Engineers). Active state in orange-500. Show a 'Case Board' with SLA countdown pills (e.g., '14m remaining' in red/orange).

section_background.description: Optional: Can be used as a low-opacity (opacity-10 to opacity-20) background or mask-image layer behind the dark bg-slate-950 Service Desk section to add a premium, subtle texture instead of flat color.

testing.requirements: All new interactive and key informational elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-partners-link', data-testid='service-desk-signup-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE NAVIGATION: In the main Header component, update the 'Engineers' navigation item to 'Partners' to correctly represent both individual engineers and service companies/suppliers.

CREATE NEW SECTION: Create a new React component (e.g., `ServiceDeskPromo`) and place it on the Homepage. Optimal placement is below the `ModuleGrid` and `CustomerExperience`, but ABOVE the `EngineerBanner`.
APPLY HIGH CONTRAST: To separate this B2B supplier audience from the gym audience, wrap this new section in a dark background (`bg-slate-950`) with generous vertical padding (`py-24`).

BUILD CSS MOCKUP: Do not use static images for the product screenshot. Build a JSX-based product mockup. Make it a light-theme dashboard with a left sidebar (showing items like Cases, Scheduler, Equipment) and a main area showing a 'Case Board' with SLA countdowns. Use `orange-500` for active states and primary buttons inside the mockup.
CONTENT: Ensure the copy highlights the 14-day free trial, self-serve signup, and 4-step setup wizard. Link the primary CTA to `/service-provider/signup`. Apply `orange-500` to the CTA.
I18N: Wrap all new user-facing text strings in the existing `t()` translation function.
TESTING: Add `data-testid` attributes to the new nav link and the new CTA button.
